No cheat sheet in lab quiz and midterm is a negative. So you need to memorize scanners and split and parse int and all that fun stuff. I also feel like lab quiz and lab final should last a little longer since we’re trying to write error-free code in first try with a fairly strict time limit. Other than that, it feels fast paced but you see the reason in the last weeks: They’re transitioning you from C to Java so it’s a whole new paradigm of Object Oriented Programming, and in the last weeks they give you exposure to data structures like lists, sets, and maps. Lastly, don’t sweat about the project, it’s fairly simple.

PS: Study these topics for the midterm: parseInt, split, method overloading, method overriding.

PS 2: For the lab final, solve the last 2 lab guides very carefully and write the methods/classes you want to remember and Lab instructor (Engin hoca in my case) emphasizes on your cheat sheet. The lab final exam (LFE) is very similar to last 2 lab guides.

PS 3: Why do we have to catch the specific hours on GUI application in lab and lecture but we have no notes or slides on moodle if we miss that? Maybe some of us need to review stuff multiple times throughout the semester? I get that self studying and researching and independence and bla bla but give me a break. Not everything needs to be a challenge for the students, this ain’t no survivor or stuff.
